slides.texte_overlay:
Unusual hobbies that make
you more attractive
Learn to play the piano. Even five simple songs. Sitting down at a piano at a friend's place and playing something beautiful is a quietly magnetic moment.
Try boxing. It builds confidence, fitness and discipline, and it teaches you to stay calm under pressure. A man who can handle himself carries himself differently.
Learn to make cocktails. Three classics, done properly. Hosting friends and making them a great drink turns any evening at your place into a memory.
Take up sketching. A small notebook, a pencil, ten minutes in a café. Drawing what you see makes you more observant, and people love seeing your little drawings.
Before: no hobbies, just my phone. After: five minutes a day of history, art or science, and a curiosity that pushed me into new hobbies and new people.
slides.texte_sophia: Before: no hobbies, just my phone. After: five minutes a day on a micro-learning app like the Sophia app. History, art, science. Now I have new hobbies and new people.

slides.texte_overlay: Learn to sail or row. Water sports take you outdoors, teach teamwork and give you great weekend stories. Few things are more attractive than a man at ease on a boat.
Grow your own herbs and vegetables. Cooking with basil and tomatoes from your own balcony shows patience, care and a calm way of living that people notice.
